patent.title: A hair styling appliance
patent.family_note: Holdout INT-13 (international R0). Do not map via Airwrap brand fame alone or sibling styling patents; require public EP3941306→SKU chart.

knowledge_origin.description: Dyson Technology Ltd assignee; corporate RD assumed.

technology.problem: Dry and straighten a hair tress with heated airflow while reducing plate-style heat damage and improving strand alignment.
technology.mechanism: Two pivotable arms forming a cavity; each arm has a plenum fed by a fan unit; air outlets along inner walls emit laminar airflow at 30–60° (preferably ~40–50°) toward a lower edge; optional slot width ~1–3 mm.

value_carriers.name: Dyson Airstrait / Airwrap haircare styling product line (candidate; multi-SKU)
value_carriers.description: Same assignee brand. Public Airwrap = Coanda attachments; Airstrait marketing is suggestive of aperture/angle ranges but does not name this grant or chart claim-1 dual-plenum elements. Claims check FAIL.

gaps.description: No public evidence naming EP3941306 on a commercial SKU with a claims chart to dual-arm plenums + 30–60° outlets.
needed_evidence: Independent claims chart to Airstrait (or other) SKU

notes: Holdout INT-13. T0=2026-10-13. Claims FAIL → R0. Brand/product narrative ≠ this grant. Formal V0.7; not V0.8.
